scope: two new NAI5 storyboards followed by built-in repaint

items.concept: Sword-riding immortal. Fresh waist-up three-quarter rear close shot: woman seated on the flat of one flying black sword, turning her face back over her shoulder toward viewer. One hand rests on the sword beneath her hip. Sword crosses lower frame diagonally and exits left; legs and boots outside crop. Face is focal point in upper middle-right, one broad ponytail sweeps left. Calm airborne poise, strong simple silhouette, no sword halo.

items.concept: A sword thrust misses an evasive woman. Side three-quarter waist-up shot: one straight broad blade enters from left at chest height, visible point stops left of center. Woman leans backward into the right third, chest clearly beyond the point with visible empty gap. An intact discarded dark jacket falls at lower left, below the blade, with one sleeve hanging downward; her open hand has just released it. Blade, jacket and woman are separate silhouettes. No piercing, cloth hole, wound or weapon contact.
